questions.question: Who does Psalm 91 say will abide in the shadow of the Almighty?
options: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High
He who is mighty and strong in battle
He who keeps the law of the LORD day and night
He who brings the costliest of offerings
questions.answer: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High

questions.question: What does God promise concerning his angels?
options: He will command them to guard you in all your ways
They will sit in judgment over the deeds of men
They will carry your prayers up to the throne of God
They will withdraw and leave you to your own strength
questions.answer: He will command them to guard you in all your ways

questions.question: The psalm says you will not fear the terror of the night nor the arrow that flies by day.
I will say to the LORD, 'My refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I _____.'
He will cover you with his pinions, and under his _____ you will find refuge.
